correctness.rationale: Two-idempotent equations reduce bijectively to an explicitly solved anticommutator block system. Fixing ranks of A and K gives q^(rs) choices for C,H; every compatible CH has q^(a²+(r−a)²) B solutions. Gaussian-binomial idempotent counts yield the displayed formula; block upper triangularity proves equal ranks and full support. All 13 exhaustive finite-field test cases pass.

value.rationale: Counting ordered witnesses, refined by summand rank, for every square-zero target is a canonical quantitative version of an established idempotent sum representation problem. The formula holds uniformly for arbitrary dimension, target square-zero rank and characteristic-two extension field, and yields a nontrivial equal-rank rigidity law; a mere representability criterion cannot determine the distribution.
